name: civitai-block-starter-elements
description: Vite + TypeScript starter for building Civitai Apps with web components — no UI framework. The recommended default; `civitai-block-starter` is the React alternative.
comment-overrides: SECURITY CONSTRAINTS ON TRANSITIVE DEPENDENCIES. Declared HERE, in the
starter's own manifest, because that is what travels: `npx tiged
copies this directory alone, and the monorepo root's pnpm.overrides is NOT
part of the copy -- so a constraint kept only there protects the monorepo and
nothing a developer actually runs. Same rule, same reasoning and same two
blocks as starters/civitai-block-starter/package.json, which carries the full
explanation (including why BOTH `overrides` and `pnpm.overrides` are needed,
and the expected `This will not take effect` warning inside the workspace).
